entities.summary: Juan Gabriel Castro, is a Mexican professional baseball coach and former infielder, who played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Cincinnati Reds, Minnesota Twins, Baltimore Orioles, and Philadelphia Phillies, during his 17-year big league career. He currently serves as the manager for the Acereros de Monclova of the Mexican League.
